label: chili-messy
text: grandmas chili - brown 1lb ground beef w/ an onion, add a can of kidney beans, 2 cans diced tomato, 2 tbsp chili powder, cumin, simmer 30 min. salt to taste.

label: marinara-clean
text:
Simple Marinara Sauce. Serves 4.
Ingredients:
3 tbsp olive oil
4 cloves garlic, minced
28 oz can crushed tomatoes
salt and pepper to taste
1/4 cup fresh basil
Method:
1. Heat oil over medium, cook garlic 1 minute until fragrant.
2. Add tomatoes, season, simmer 20 minutes.
3. Stir in basil off the heat.

label: daiquiri-bar
text: Classic Daiquiri (1 drink). 2 oz white rum, 1 oz fresh lime juice, 0.75 oz simple syrup. Shake with ice, strain into a chilled coupe. Garnish with a lime wheel.

label: pancakes-fractions
text:
Fluffy Pancakes, makes 8.
1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
3 1/2 tsp baking powder
1 tsp salt
1 tbsp sugar
1 1/4 cups milk
1 egg
3 tbsp melted butter
Mix dry, whisk in wet, cook on a greased griddle until bubbles form, flip.

label: stirfry-narrative
text: So for this chicken stir fry I just grab about a pound of chicken thighs and cut them into strips, toss with a splash of soy sauce. Get a wok screaming hot with a bit of oil, sear the chicken, throw in a couple cloves of garlic and some ginger, then a bag of frozen stir fry veg. Finish with more soy and a drizzle of sesame oil. Serve over rice.

label: cookies-groups
text:
Glazed Lemon Cookies.
For the cookies: 2 cups flour, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 3/4 cup butter, 1 cup sugar, 1 egg, zest of 1 lemon.
For the glaze: 1 cup powdered sugar, 2 tbsp lemon juice.
Cream butter and sugar, add egg and zest, mix in dry, bake at 350 for 10 min. Whisk glaze and drizzle over cooled cookies.

label: soup-vague
text: Weeknight veg soup: a knob of butter, a large onion diced, a couple handfuls of chopped carrots and celery, a splash of white wine, then cover with stock and simmer till soft. Blend if you like. Season well.

label: tacos-typical
text: Ground Beef Tacos, serves 4. 1 lb ground beef, 1 packet taco seasoning, 2/3 cup water, 8 corn tortillas, 1 cup shredded cheddar, shredded lettuce, 1 diced tomato. Brown beef, add seasoning and water, simmer 5 min. Warm tortillas and fill.
